evals.prompt: I want to fix some typos in my deck myself, it's keynote-pro/examples/quarterly-review.html — open it in the editor for me
evals.expected_output: Runs open-editor.sh on the deck, gives the URL and short how-to (click to type, notes, Save to same file), does not rewrite the deck itself.

evals.prompt: can you change slide 3 of quarterly-review.html to a two-column layout with risks and mitigations? or should I do that in the editor
evals.expected_output: Recognises this is structural, not wording: does it via present-in-html instead of sending the user to the editor.
